_comment: Regions published as static tiles. extract = Geofabrik path of the source extract (its .poly marks where data is complete); publish = which area to publish: a Geofabrik .poly path or a circle.

regionRequests._comment: Games send region requests and activity to the request endpoint (contract v1 in src/client/gamegis-client.js; today a Google Apps Script web app, see service/requests-endpoint). Its address is public. The list of collected signals is read through the REQUESTS_CSV_URL secret of the tiles repository (endpoint address + read key), never stored here.
regionRequests._comment_rating: Areas follow where people play; growth, give-back, size caps and expiry adapt to each area's activity and get stricter as storage fills (strictness 0 below 50% of budgetMB, 1 above 90%). Tuning defaults: DEMAND_DEFAULTS in src/requests/regionRequests.js. Pinned regions below are never changed.

_comment_mirrors: Public copies of the tile site besides GitHub Pages (listed in manifest.mirrors; games fail over automatically).
